description: Phrases to introduce what the visual data illustrates without copying the prompt.

phrases.phrase: The line graph delineates the proportion of...
phrases.example: The line graph delineates the proportion of renewable energy consumption across three European nations between 2010 and 2025.

phrases.phrase: The bar chart provides a comparative breakdown of...
phrases.example: The bar chart provides a comparative breakdown of global expenditure on primary education across five continents.

phrases.phrase: The pie charts illustrate the percentage distribution of...
phrases.example: The pie charts illustrate the percentage distribution of household waste disposal methods over a ten-year timeframe.

phrases.phrase: The table enumerates the volume of...
phrases.example: The table enumerates the volume of international tourist arrivals and their corresponding fiscal expenditures.

phrases.phrase: The diagram illustrates the sequential stages involved in...
phrases.example: The diagram illustrates the sequential stages involved in the desalination of seawater for municipal consumption.

phrases.phrase: The pair of maps illustrates the infrastructural transformations undergone by...
phrases.example: The pair of maps illustrates the infrastructural transformations undergone by a coastal village following port expansion.

description: Dynamic verbs and collocations to describe upward, downward, and volatile trajectories.

phrases.phrase: experienced a meteoric surge, culminating at...
phrases.example: Solar energy adoption experienced a meteoric surge, culminating at 12.5 gigawatts by 2024.

phrases.phrase: witnessed a steady upward trajectory throughout the surveyed timeframe
phrases.example: Electric vehicle sales witnessed a steady upward trajectory throughout the surveyed timeframe.

phrases.phrase: plummeted precipitously before bottoming out at...
phrases.example: Coal production plummeted precipitously before bottoming out at barely two million metric tons.

phrases.phrase: exhibited mild fluctuations, oscillating between... and...
phrases.example: Wholesale wheat prices exhibited mild fluctuations, oscillating between $180 and $210 per ton.

phrases.phrase: plateaued and remained largely static for the remainder of the period
phrases.example: Desktop computer sales plateaued and remained largely static for the remainder of the period.

phrases.phrase: doubled fourfold, eclipsing previous historic records
phrases.example: Passenger traffic doubled fourfold, eclipsing previous historic records established in the 1990s.

categoryTitle: Task 1 Academic: Comparative Analysis & Data Extremes
description: Formulas to make precise mathematical and proportional comparisons between categories.

phrases.phrase: outstripped its nearest competitor by a substantial margin of...
phrases.example: China outstripped its nearest competitor by a substantial margin of over 5 million electric vehicles.

phrases.phrase: accounted for the lion's share of total expenditure, standing at...
phrases.example: Housing accommodation accounted for the lion's share of total expenditure, standing at roughly 42%.

phrases.phrase: constituted a negligible fraction, registering a modest...
phrases.example: Geothermal power constituted a negligible fraction, registering a modest 0.4% of total energy output.

phrases.phrase: in stark contrast to..., which registered a mere...
phrases.example: Urban smartphone penetration stood at 89%, in stark contrast to rural areas, which registered a mere 28%.

phrases.phrase: was roughly three times higher than that of...
phrases.example: The proportion of graduate degree holders in city A was roughly three times higher than that of city B.

phrases.phrase: stood at virtually identical levels, hovering around...
phrases.example: Enrollment rates in biology and chemistry stood at virtually identical levels, hovering around 15,000 students.

categoryTitle: Task 1 General Training: Letter Openings & Sign-Offs
description: Formulas for formal, semi-formal, and informal IELTS letters.

phrases.phrase: I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding...
phrases.example: I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding the unacceptable delay in repairing the heating system in apartment 4B.

phrases.phrase: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for the exceptional service provided by...
phrases.example: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for the exceptional service provided by your conference support staff.

phrases.phrase: I am writing to inquire about the possibility of...
phrases.example: I am writing to inquire about the possibility of rescheduling my professional accreditation examination.

phrases.phrase: I hope you are doing well! I'm writing to see if you'd like to join me for...
phrases.function: Informal letter: Invitation to a friend
phrases.example: I hope you are doing well! I'm writing to see if you'd like to join me for a weekend hiking trip in the highlands.

phrases.phrase: I am writing to bring an urgent matter to your immediate attention regarding...
phrases.function: Semi-formal letter: Notice to landlord or manager
phrases.example: I am writing to bring an urgent matter to your immediate attention regarding persistent water leaks in the stairwell.

phrases.phrase: Yours sincerely, / Yours faithfully, / Warm regards,
phrases.example: Use 'Yours faithfully' when recipient name is unknown (Dear Sir/Madam); use 'Yours sincerely' when name is known (Dear Mr. Davis).

description: Phrases to present the contemporary background debate and state an unambiguous position.

phrases.phrase: Whether... or... has become a subject of considerable controversy in modern discourse.
phrases.example: Whether artificial intelligence will replace classroom teachers has become a subject of considerable controversy in modern discourse.

phrases.phrase: While some contend that..., I firmly adhere to the view that...
phrases.example: While some contend that higher education should be purely vocational, I firmly adhere to the view that liberal arts foster critical societal reasoning.

phrases.phrase: This essay will critically examine both perspectives before articulating a balanced conclusion.
phrases.example: This essay will critically examine both perspectives before articulating a balanced, evidence-based conclusion.

phrases.phrase: In contemporary society, an increasing number of individuals argue that...
phrases.example: In contemporary society, an increasing number of individuals argue that personal lifestyle changes alone cannot combat climate change.

phrases.phrase: There is a compelling justification for the assertion that...
phrases.example: There is a compelling justification for the assertion that mandatory physical fitness in schools combats the childhood obesity epidemic.

categoryTitle: Task 2 Essay: Presenting Opposing Perspectives Neutrally
description: Academic structures to acknowledge counter-arguments without sounding dismissive.

phrases.phrase: Proponents of this standpoint maintain that...
phrases.example: Proponents of this standpoint maintain that space exploration drives technological spin-offs that benefit terrestrial medicine.

phrases.phrase: Advocates argue, with some justification, that...
phrases.example: Advocates argue, with some justification, that heavy vehicle congestion charges discourage discretionary car trips in city centers.

phrases.phrase: On the other hand, skeptics question the viability of this approach, contending that...
phrases.example: On the other hand, skeptics question the viability of this approach, contending that punitive carbon taxes disproportionately burden low-income families.

phrases.phrase: It is widely acknowledged that..., yet this premise fails to account for...
phrases.example: It is widely acknowledged that remote work saves commuting time, yet this premise fails to account for the erosion of team cohesion.

phrases.phrase: A commonly cited counter-argument is that...
phrases.example: A commonly cited counter-argument is that historical monuments demand astronomical maintenance budgets that drain municipal reserves.

categoryTitle: Task 2 Essay: Providing Examples & Empirical Evidence
description: Formulas to integrate realistic illustrations without sounding informal or anecdotal.

phrases.phrase: A prime illustration of this phenomenon can be observed in...
phrases.example: A prime illustration of this phenomenon can be observed in Scandinavian penal institutions, where vocational training drastically reduces recidivism.

phrases.phrase: Empirical studies conducted by... corroborate the view that...
phrases.example: Empirical studies conducted by pediatric researchers corroborate the view that excessive early screen exposure impairs linguistic acquisition.

phrases.phrase: To substantiate this claim, one need look no further than...
phrases.example: To substantiate this claim, one need look no further than Singapore's integrated multimodal public transport network.

phrases.phrase: For instance, statistical data from municipal surveys reveals that...
phrases.example: For instance, statistical data from municipal surveys reveals that introducing protected bicycle lanes boosted active commuting by 45%.

phrases.phrase: A notable historical precedent is...
phrases.example: A notable historical precedent is the global eradication of smallpox through coordinated international public health vaccination campaigns.

categoryTitle: Task 2 Essay: Academic Hedging & Forceful Conclusions
description: Cautious academic hedging and memorable synthesizing conclusion formulas.

phrases.phrase: It is arguably plausible that...; nonetheless,...
phrases.example: It is arguably plausible that automation reduces manual entry-level roles; nonetheless, it generates sophisticated engineering demands.

phrases.phrase: In the final analysis, while... offers undeniable advantages, it is ultimately...
phrases.example: In the final analysis, while vocational proficiency offers undeniable quick employment, it is ultimately university education that fosters visionary leaders.

phrases.phrase: To recapitulate, although both arguments possess merit, the weight of evidence suggests that...
phrases.example: To recapitulate, although both arguments possess merit, the weight of evidence suggests that centralized state legislation is indispensable for carbon neutrality.

phrases.phrase: Unless decisive multilateral measures are enacted promptly, the repercussions will likely...
phrases.example: Unless decisive multilateral measures are enacted promptly, the repercussions for global biodiversity will prove irreversible.

phrases.phrase: Taking all factors into consideration, a pragmatic compromise involves...
phrases.example: Taking all factors into consideration, a pragmatic compromise involves integrating practical corporate internships into theoretical academic degree programs.
